description: This file defines the AuthService class responsible for authentication-related network operations in the Flutter application, including login, registration, profile fetching, logout, and token persistence.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: A service class handling authentication-related API calls, token storage, and user profile management.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login with email and password, stores JWT token upon success.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, optional full name, and role.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Fetches the current authenticated user's profile information.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the stored JWT token to log out the user.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the persisted JWT token from local storage.
